dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor convex protrusion visible along the left lateral margin; the right lateral margin is obscured by water surface turbulence and foam.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median light-grey pixel intensity; categorized as an intermediate phase between slate-grey and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse dark-grey pixel clusters distributed across the posterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey canvas and the darker mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark elliptical aperture (blowhole) at the anterior; series of faint, low-contrast vertical linear striations visible on the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple healed vertical linear striations (rake marks) across the central dorsal surface.
